title: A typewriter with steps()
summary: steps(21) jumps the width one character at a time, with ch units and a blinking caret border.
explanation: steps(n) is a timing function that jumps instead of gliding: the animation is cut into n equal jumps. The text is 21 characters, the width animates from 0 to 21ch, and with steps(21) each jump reveals exactly one character.
That only lines up in a monospace font, where every character is 1ch wide. white-space: nowrap keeps the text on one line and overflow: hidden hides what is not revealed yet.
The caret is the element's right border. A second animation, blink, toggles its colour with steps(1) so it switches on and off instead of fading. Two animations run at once, separated by a comma.
tryThis: Change steps(21) to ease: the letters are sliced in half as the width glides.
Change the font to system-ui, sans-serif: the jumps stop matching the letters.
Press Apply here again to replay it.
